objective: Maximize fair and transferable ARI/NMI/Q on the current development panel, prioritizing human lymph and P22 mouse brain, by combining adaptive graph reliability, stronger clustering heads, and lightweight relational representation learning.

common_affinity_contract.input: Night-6C/Night-6D canonical six saved views per dataset-seed, located only through verified manifests
common_affinity_contract.kernel: same self-tuning kernel implementation and numerical semantics as Night-6D/Night-7A H05

EIGEN_MCLUST_EEE.eigenvectors: K smallest with deterministic sign canonicalization

EIGEN_MCLUST_VVV.eigenvectors: K smallest with deterministic sign canonicalization

EIGEN_KMEANS100.eigenvectors: K smallest with deterministic sign canonicalization

reliability_contract.graph_summary_embedding: mean of the three row-L2 normalized canonical views within each graph, followed by row-L2 normalization
reliability_contract.own_prediction_error: Euclidean distance between Z_g[i] and the mean Z_g over g's own k10 affinity neighbors
reliability_contract.cross_prediction_error: Euclidean distance between Z_g[i] and the mean Z_g over the other graph's k10 affinity neighbors
reliability_contract.local_weight: softmax across G00/G04 of clipped(raw_reliability/scale,-10,10) for each spot
reliability_contract.global_weight: softmax across G00/G04 of the spot-mean clipped(raw_reliability/scale,-10,10)
reliability_contract.output: arithmetic symmetrization of directed mix, zero diagonal

head_stage.promotion: top two distinct partition-head templates by the locked ranking; H00 remains a mandatory fallback comparator but does not consume a promoted slot unless ranked top two

adapter_architecture.inputs: six canonical saved embeddings, two graphs x three view roles
adapter_architecture.graph_summary: mean of three projected views within graph followed by row-L2 normalization
adapter_architecture.equal_fusion: mean of G00 and G04 summaries
adapter_architecture.residual_adapter: Linear(64,128) + GELU + Dropout(0.1) + Linear(128,64), residual add, then row-L2
adapter_architecture.moe_gate_when_enabled: MLP([u_G00,u_G04,abs(u_G00-u_G04),four fixed local reliability scalars],128,2) + softmax
adapter_architecture.checkpoint: mandatory final state_dict plus optimizer/config/RNG state and SHA; immediate reload must reproduce fused embedding and both endpoint partitions exactly

loss_contract.RECON: mean MSE reconstructing all six row-L2 input views; weight 1.0 in every recipe
loss_contract.RELKL: average KL from fused top20 sparse similarity distribution to each of six stop-gradient input-view top20 distributions; tau 0.1; weight 1.0
loss_contract.CLIP: symmetric same-spot InfoNCE over all registered canonical cross-view pairs; other spots are negatives; tau 0.1; weight 0.2
loss_contract.MNN: TripletMarginLoss margin 0.5 using precomputed mutual k10 positives and deterministic negatives from farthest 50 percent; weight 0.2
loss_contract.MASK: deterministic 15 percent spot mask per view and seed, reconstruct masked projected target; weight 0.5
loss_contract.SEMANTIC: cross-entropy to stop-gradient pseudo-cluster target from the locked best H-stage partition, only top 60 percent confidence within each predicted cluster; target temperature 0.5; weight 0.2
loss_contract.MOE_BALANCE: expert importance CV squared plus load CV squared; weight 0.01
loss_contract.DCCA: negative sum of top 32 canonical correlations between G00 and G04 summaries with 1e-3 ridge; weight 0.05

R1.matrix: 10 recipes x 8 dataset-seed units; each training reused for 2 endpoints x 2 promoted heads
R1.promotion: top four recipe-endpoint-head configurations by locked ranking, with at most four unique recipes

R2.matrix: up to four promoted configurations x 22 remaining dataset-seed units; training is reused when configurations share a recipe

metric_contract.balanced_macro_Q: equal mean over four dataset mean Q values
metric_contract.seed_weighting: first average within dataset, never pool spots or let D1/P22 ten seeds double dataset weight
metric_contract.paired_deltas: same dataset and seed versus C00

failure_policy.scientific_numerical_failure: preserve logs and outputs, no fallback, no same-cell retry, continue the matrix
failure_policy.global_implementation_bug_before_relevan: preserve invalid attempt, fix once globally, rerun every affected cell uniformly within correction budget
failure_policy.bug_discovered_after_relevant_stage_labe: do not selectively repair; invalidate the entire affected candidate-stage comparison and report
failure_policy.budget_exhaustion: stop without promoting an incomplete candidate

forbidden_actions: call AutoDL power API or automatically start the experimental Codex task
run this matrix in CPU-only no-card mode

select best epoch, best seed, best retry, or per-dataset candidate
change candidate formulas, loss weights, K, seeds, thresholds, endpoints, or partition settings after their stage evaluation opens labels
silently fallback from a failed solver or add a result-dependent epsilon
overwrite Night-6C, Night-6D, or Night-7A artifacts
copy unlicensed upstream source into the repository
run a formal modern-baseline benchmark or claim SOTA in Night-7B
download raw runs, checkpoints, source repositories, or caches to Windows C drive
